shared_qualifications: PDF p.3 explicitly assigns 609, 758 and 515 mV SCE to 3Mo, 3W–1.5Mo and 2W–2Mo, respectively. Source says these representative curves are close to averages of five polarization tests; no individual replicates are invented. Figure 1 solid/dotted ordering appears reversed relative to text; the registered text assignment is preserved.

Table 1 analyses identify the alloys; Fig.1 results are solution-annealed at 80°C in deaerated 4 M NaCl. CRA generic heat treatment includes aging, but is not evidence that these three values were measured on aged specimens. CRA scan 1 mV/s is explicitly printed for the CPT preparation on p.2, not securely established for the separate polarization results. Numerical pH 7 is not supplied.
CPT outcomes at 600 mV SCE retain temperature coordinates and source aging/baseline conflicts. They are not numerical 600 mV polarization thresholds and are not linked to the three CRA rows.
